defect.proposed_fix: Keep field_i_validity: good_law, but replace 'No negative treatment.' with 'No audited negative treatment or point override in the lake record; proposed progeny flags remain audit-needed.'

reasons: Lake final treatment field_i_validity is good_law as of 2026-06-30 and point_overrides is empty.

The scope note itself warns that S2 derivation may downgrade.
residual_risks: Resolving whether any proposed progeny flag is a true negative event would require an audit beyond the disclosed record.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use 'No audited negative treatment in this lake record' instead of 'No negative treatment.'
